architecture.mechanism: Using a spark plug as a sensor to monitor the state of the combustion system in real time, detecting irregularities in arc duration, flashover voltage, and high-voltage waveforms that indicate combustion problems across cylinders.
architecture.intervention: Install non-contact voltage sensors on the spark plugs of the 2020 Hyundai Tucson to continuously monitor combustion state across all cylinders, enabling real-time detection of cylinder-specific misfires or combustion irregularities responsible for intermittent stalling during acceleration.
architecture.falsification_test: If spark plug sensor monitoring shows uniform combustion parameters across all cylinders during stalling events, then the stalling cause is not combustion-related and this mechanism would fail to resolve the issue.
